title: PACK-19 Cycle Life Ageing Study
text: PACK-19 was cycled at 1 C charge and 1 C discharge to 80 percent depth of discharge at 35 degC. Capacity fade reached 20 percent after 780 cycles, short of the 1000 cycle requirement. Cells nearest the BMS-2 board aged fastest, tracking a 6 degC gradient across the module.
